metadata.title: That 1 kill where I forgot I was even playing and Valorant said ‘Sure, why not?’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get that without even trying?
Enemy probably paused their brain mid-round.
Click if your aim’s mostly ‘oops’ but kills still drop!
Valorant logic is peak comedy again.

Tap in if your kills come with zero effort and max confusion!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
